reviews.text: ...Not a guesthouse but an excellent holiday destination for our beloved Leon!!!!... Compliments to the staff and Domenico!!!!👏👍 …
Excellent structure, excellent spaces and above all great friendliness and availability

I left my dog ​​Simba and rabbit Steve for 10 days in August, and honestly, I was nervous because it was my first time there, but I had a truly positive experience. The facility is well-organized, clean, and designed with animal welfare in mind. During my stay, I received updates and saw my dog ​​calm and happy. It's reassuring to know you can leave your pets in trustworthy hands. I highly recommend it.
We finally found a place where our cat was cared for and welcomed beautifully. Domenico is someone who loves and cares for the furry ones entrusted to him. THANK YOU

I've known Bau House for two years.
Professional, kind, and approachable.
Highly recommended!

I contacted this facility a little reluctantly because I had never left my puppy alone. After an inspection during which I was able to confirm the cleanliness, large spaces, and lots of greenery, I decided to leave Maya. Mr. Domenico immediately proved to be competent and attentive to my dog's needs and tried in every way to meet my expectations. During my vacation, he sent me videos of Maya, keeping me constantly updated on her condition.
When I went to pick her up after six days, I found her spotless, playful, and happy.
We have been entrusting Maya to
Mr. Domenico for seven years now and hope to continue doing so, confident that it was the right choice. Thank you for everything, see you soon. The Soprano family and Maya 🐶

I took my cat to this facility for about 10 days.
I had a great time, and my cat was well cared for and given adequate space.
I have been bringing my Macchia to the bau house for eight years, I am very happy with it, I receive a lot of attention, courtesy and professionalism, I highly recommend it

Negative experience
When I went to pick up my dog ​​and he had scratches on his nose, I immediately took him to the vet for antibiotics since they couldn't determine the cause (actually, we noticed it ourselves and were told to apply a cream, which the vet advised against and that we were overdoing it).
I also paid for the bath, but the dog was returned to me with a dirty bottom and dirty eyes. When I asked why, I was told it needed time.
The long waiting period doesn't justify all this.

I won't tell you my experience because even if I want to summarize it, it would take a book to write it. I'll just tell you to stay away and before leaving your animals in their care, read the contract you sign carefully because they exonerate themselves from any responsibility for the health of the dog. They are not serious and they are not professional.
